page_title: CAG 0-2 INT | Cagliari v Inter 27/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's the end of the match.
90+3' Inter string together a series of short passes.
90' We will have 3 min. of added time.
89' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Lautaro Martinez as he is replaced by Ange-Yoan Bonny (Inter).
86' Cagliari work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

85' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but he fails to change the score as his effort deflects away off the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.

82' 0 - 2 Goal! Federico Dimarco displays great vision and sends a pass to Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball from close range in the back of the net. The score is 0:2.
81' Marco Piccinini interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Marco Palestra (Cagliari). A free kick has been awarded to Inter.
80' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.

80' Gennaro Borrelli (Cagliari) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked. The linesman makes the right call and Cagliari will have a corner.
79' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
78' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Inter force their opponents to concede a corner.
78' Fabio Pisacane prepares a substitution. Michael Folorunsho is replaced by Gennaro Borrelli (Cagliari).
78' The referee signals a substitution. Riyad Idrissi (Cagliari) is brought on as a substitute for Adam Obert.
77' Wasted opportunity. Manuel Akanji (Inter) gets to the rebound inside the box and smashes the ball just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
74' Michael Folorunsho (Cagliari) latches on to the corner kick inside the box, but his header from near the penalty spot crashes against the right post! The goalkeeper would have been helpless.
73' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
73' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Marco Palestra (Cagliari). Cagliari force a corner. They send men into the box.
72' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Denzel Dumfries (Inter) comes onto the pitch so that Luis Henrique can be given a rest.
69' Mattia Felici (Cagliari) prepares to take a corner kick.
69' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) jumps into a tackle and Marco Piccinini signals a foul. It's a free kick to Cagliari, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.

65' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement. Cagliari are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
64' Here is a change. Marcus Thuram is going off and Cristian Chivu gives the last tactical orders to Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter).
64' A substitution has been made. Nicolo Barella is replaced by Davide Frattesi (Inter).
62' Marco Palestra (Cagliari) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
62' Cagliari enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
60' The foul by Nicolo Barella (Inter) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Marco Piccinini.
58' Fabio Pisacane has decided to substitute Jose Pedro and he is replaced by Mattia Felici (Cagliari).
58' Here comes a substitution. Alessandro Deiola is given a rest as he is replaced by Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari).
56' Corner kick. Federico Dimarco (Inter) is ready to send the ball into the box.

56' The ball is out of play. Inter will have a chance to score from a corner. Federico Dimarco (Inter) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.

55' Marcus Thuram (Inter) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the left post is blocked by Elia Caprile, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.

53' What a chance that is! Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) wastes a huge opportunity as he receives a beautiful pass on the edge of the box and fires towards the net. Unfortunately for him, he only hits the right post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
51' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) brings his opponent down. Marco Piccinini has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Cagliari have a free kick.
50' A cross from Marco Palestra (Cagliari) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
48' Cagliari control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
46' Yerry Mina (Cagliari) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Marco Piccinini blows for a foul. Inter have a free kick.
46' Half-time substitution. Cristian Chivu decided to make a change. Carlos Augusto is replaced by Federico Dimarco (Inter).
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Marco Palestra (Cagliari) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball has crossed the sideline. Cagliari are taking a throw-in.
45+1' Carlos Augusto (Inter) is awarded a yellow card for his behaviour.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
45' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
44' Andrea Belotti is substituted due to injury. Fabio Pisacane gives a chance to Matteo Prati (Cagliari).
42' Andrea Belotti (Cagliari) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
41' The linesman raises his flag. Andrea Belotti (Cagliari) is adjudged offside.
38' Marcus Thuram (Inter) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
36' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. It's a throw-in for Inter.
33' Marcus Thuram (Inter) commits a foul and Marco Piccinini immediately signals a free kick. Cagliari win a free kick.
28' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) is about to take a corner kick.
28' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) steps up to send the ball in.
25' Great teamplay by Cagliari as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
23' Marco Piccinini blows for a foul after Jose Pedro (Cagliari) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Inter are awarded the free kick.
20' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.

16' Michael Folorunsho (Cagliari) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Inter.

15' Carlos Augusto (Inter) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Marco Piccinini blows his whistle for a foul. Cagliari win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
14' The Inter players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
12' Marcus Thuram (Inter) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
9' 0 - 1 Lautaro Martinez (Inter) scores from quite a difficult position as he leaps high to connect with a cross and powers his header inside the left post. Excellent finish.
7' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. It's a free kick to Cagliari in a dangerous position.
3' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) commits a rough foul. Marco Piccinini stops the game and makes a call. Free kick. Cagliari will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Cagliari will have the kick-off.
Marco Piccinini will officiate today.
